2317-6664-7084-8250.description:
Activate Scarland Thrinax by sacrificing another nonland creature you control.
When the creature dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, earthbending Dwarven Mine.
Resolve the Scarland Thrinax ability, putting a +1/+1 counter on Scarland Thrinax
Activate Scarland Thrinax by sacrificing Dwarven Mine.
When Dwarven Mine dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, returning Dwarven Mine from your graveyard to the battlefield untapped due to The Wandering Minstrel
When Dwarven Mine enters, it triggers, creating a 1/1 Dwarf creature token.
Resolve the Scarland Thrinax ability, putting a +1/+1 counter on Scarland Thrinax
Repeat.

574-4694-5805-7306.notablePrerequisites:
At least one opponent has lost life this turn.
You control at least one additional creature with a +1/+1 counter on it.
574-4694-5805-7306.description:
Activate Vish Kal by sacrificing a creature with a +1/+1 counter on it.
When that creature dies, The Ooze triggers, creating a Mutagen artifact token for each +1/+1 counter on the sacrificed creature. These artifacts are also 0/0 creatures due to March of the Machines.
Each Mutagen artifact creature token enters with at least one +1/+1 counter on it due to Gev.
Resolve Vish Kal's ability, putting a number of +1/+1 counters on them equal to the sacrificed creature's power.
Repeat from step 1.
574-4694-5805-7306.notes: Once Vish Kal has infinite +1/+1 counters, you may activate its last ability any number of times to reduce the toughnesses of any number of creatures to 0.

1339-1832-2034-7918.easyPrerequisites: Your life total is at least 2.
1339-1832-2034-7918.description:
Activate Unfulfilled Desires by paying {1} and 1 life, causing you to loot.
The Locust God triggers, creating a 1/1 Insect creature token with flying and haste.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing the Insect, adding {C}{C}
When the Insect dies, Sifa Grent triggers, causing you to gain 1 life and target opponent to lose 1 life.
Repeat.

2438-5254-8122.easyPrerequisites:
You control another creature with power 4 or greater.
You don't control an Army, or the only Army you do control is the creature with power 4 or greater.
2438-5254-8122.description:
Activate Carrion Feeder by sacrificing another creature with power 4 or greater. If you control an Army, ensure to sacrifice that creature.
When the creature dies, Warbeast of Gorgoroth triggers, creating a 0/0 Orc Army creature token and putting two +1/+1 counters on it.
Resolve the Carrion Feeder ability.
Repeat.
2438-5254-8122.notes: The Orc Army will become a 5/5 due to the counters and the buff provided by The Muckslinger Gang.

1479-2841-6662-8099.easyPrerequisites:
It is not your turn.
There is a land card in your library that can be fetched using Prismatic Vista.
Your life total is 2 or higher.
1479-2841-6662-8099.description:
Fetch a land using Prismatic Vista.
When the fetched land enters, Chocobo Racetrack and Kodama trigger.
Resolve the Kodama trigger, putting Ghost Town from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Ghost Town enters, Kodama and Chocobo Racetrack trigger.
Holding priority, activate Ghost Town's first abiltiy by tapping it, adding {C}.
Activate Ghost Town's second ability by paying {0}, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Chocobo Racetrack from step 4, creating a token.
When the token enters, Kodama triggers, putting Ghost Town from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Ghost Town enters, Chocobo Racetrack triggers.
Repeat from step 5.

uses.battlefieldCardState: as a copy of the creature with persist

2921-7936--5.notablePrerequisites: The creature with persist has a +1/+1 counter on it.
2921-7936--5.description:
Activate Bartolomé del Presidio by sacrificing Dominion Saboteur.
When Dominion Saboteur dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it. Choose to have it enter as a copy of the creature with persist with a +1/+1 counter on it.
Remove a +1/+1 counter and a -1/-1 counter from Dominion Saboteur as a state-based action.
Resolve the Bartolomé del Presidio ability.
Repeat.

2131-3899--5.description:
Activate Spawning Pit by sacrificing the creature with persist.
When that creature dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
Thran Vigil triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on that creature.
Remove a +1/+1 counter and a -1/-1 counter from that creature as a state-based action.
Resolve the Spawning Pit ability from step 1.
Repeat.

1170-1594-5131-6797--202.easyPrerequisites: You haven't cast an artifact spell using Muldrotha this turn.
1170-1594-5131-6797--202.description:
Cast the artifact from your graveyard using Muldrotha's ability by paying {0} due to Helm of Awakening.
Displacer Kitten triggers, blinking Muldrotha, allowing you to use its ability again this turn.
Resolve the artifact spell.
Activate Phantom Train by sacrificing the artifact, putting a +1/+1 counter on Phantom Train and causing it to become a creature until end of turn
Repeat.

1409-1849-3099-6006.description:
Activate Deadeye Navigator by tapping it, adding {U}.
Leyline of Abundance triggers, adding {G}.
Activate Deadeye Navigator by paying {1}{U}, blinking it.
When Deadeye Navigator enters the battlefield, its soulbond ability triggers, repairing it with another creature.
Repeat.

3480-4289-7686.notablePrerequisites: You control four or more Squirrels.
3480-4289-7686.description:
Activate The Unbeatable Squirrel Girl by paying {1}{G}{G}{G}, creating a 1/1 Squirrel creature token for each Squirrel you control.
Activate four Squirrels by tapping them, adding {1}{G}{G}{G}.
Repeat
3480-4289-7686.notes: You'll create double as many Squirrels each loop. All Squirrels beyond the first four will be untapped and can be used to add additional mana.

2084-7506.description:
Cast Replicate by paying its mana cost, creating a token copy of Mirror-Mad Phantasm.
Activate the Mirror-Mad Phantasm token by paying {1}{U}, shuffling the token into your library and milling your entire library due to it not having a card named Mirror-Mad Phantasm in it.

457-1792-4404-4908.easyPrerequisites: You control a creature that doesn't have summoning sickness.
457-1792-4404-4908.description:
Cast Retraction Helix by paying {U}, targeting a creature you control that doesn't have summoning sickness.
Cast Corridor Monitor by paying {U} due to Enthusiastic Mechanaut.
When Corridor Monitor enters, it triggers, untapping the creature targeted by Retraction Helix.
Activate Urza's first ability by tapping Corridor Monitor, adding {U}.
Activate the creature targeted by Retraction Helix by tapping it, returning Corridor Monitor from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat from step 2.

206-2457-4289-6753.description:
Activate Ant Queen by paying {1}{G}, creating two creature tokens.
Activate the creature tokens by tapping them, adding {1}{G}.
Repeat

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to any additional creature without summoning sickness you control

requires.n: Permanent with Landfall Ability: Create Creature Token(s)

872-3259-3478--85--106.notablePrerequisites: An opponent is unable to block and kill creatures you control.
872-3259-3478--85--106.description:
Activate Scaled Herbalist by tapping it, putting Dimir Aqueduct from your hand onto the battlefield.
Dimir Aqueduct enters the battlefield, triggering itself and the permanent with a landfall ability.
Resolve the Dimir Aqueduct trigger, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the landfall trigger, creating a creature token.
Deal combat damage to an opponent with the creature that has Breath of Fury attached.
Breath of Fury triggers, causing you to sacrifice the creature it is attached to and then attach Breath of Fury to the creature token from step 4, untap all creatures you control, and get an additional combat phase after this one.
Repeat each combat phase.

277-765-774.description:
Pay {1} to activate Patron of the Moon, putting Guildless Commons from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Guildless Commons enters, it and Tiller Engine each trigger.
Resolve Tiller Engine's ability, untapping Guildless Commons.
Activate Guildless Commons by tapping it, adding two mana.
Resolve Guildless Commons's triggered ability, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.
277-765-774.notes: After gaining an arbitrarily large amount of mana, you may repeat the loop choosing Tiller Engine's other mode to tap any number of nonland permanents opponents control.

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to another creature you control

3259-3968-6965.notablePrerequisites: An opponent cannot block creatures you control.
3259-3968-6965.description:
Declare the creature with Breath of Fury attached and Grave Titan as attackers.
Grave Titan triggers, creating a creature token.
Deal combat damage using the creature that has Breath of Fury attached. 
Breath of Fury triggers, causing you to sacrifice the creature it is attached to, then attach Breath of Fury to the creature token, then causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Repeat each combat phase.

1734-2438-3175.description:
Cast Fiend Hunter by paying its mana cost.
When Fiend Hunter enters, its first ability triggers, exiling Sun Titan.
Activate Carrion Feeder by sacrificing Fiend Hunter.
When Fiend Hunter dies, its second ability triggers, returning Sun Titan from exile to the battlefield.
When Sun Titan enters, it triggers, returning Fiend Hunter from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Fiend Hunter enters, its first ability triggers, exiling Sun Titan.
Resolve the Carrion Feeder ability.
Repeat from step 3.

232-1235-3227-4285.description:
Cast Twinflame by paying {3}{R}{R}, targeting any two creatures.
Holding priority, cast Increasing Vengeance by paying its mana cost, copying Twinflame, with the copy targeting Priest of Urabrask and Scrivener.
Resolve the copy of Twinflame, creating a token copy of Priest of Urabrask and Scrivener with haste.
When the Priest of Urabrask and Scrivener tokens enter, they trigger.
Resolve the Priest of Urabrask trigger, adding {R}{R}{R}.
Resolve the Scrivener trigger, returning Increasing Vengeance from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat from step 2.

232-1235-4285-5913.description:
Cast Twinflame by paying {3}{R}{R}, targeting any two creatures.
Holding priority, cast Increasing Vengeance by paying its mana cost, copying Twinflame, with the copy targeting Priest of Urabrask and Pinnacle Monk
Resolve the copy of Twinflame, creating a token copy of Priest of Urabrask and Pinnacle Monk with haste.
When the Priest of Urabrask and Pinnacle Monk tokens enter, they trigger.
Resolve the Priest of Urabrask trigger, adding {R}{R}{R}.
Resolve the Pinnacle Monk trigger, returning Increasing Vengeance from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat from step 2.

1183-4131-4853.description:
Activate Basalt Monolith by tapping it, adding {C}{C}{C}
Activate Pentavus's first ability by paying {1} and removing a +1/+1 counter from it, creating a 1/1 Pentavite creature token.
Activate Pentavus's second ability by paying {1} and sacrificing the Pentavite.
When the Pentavite dies, Dross Scorpion triggers, untapping Basalt Monolith.
Resolve the Pentavus ability, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Repeat.
1183-4131-4853.notes: Once you have enough mana, you can untap other artifacts using Dross Scorpion

1374-3626-5499-6965--24.notablePrerequisites:
If the Knight has two colored mana symbols in its mana cost, you have one mana of either color available.
If the Knight has three colored mana symbols in its mana cost, you have one mana of any of those colors, and two mana of any other one of those colors available.
1374-3626-5499-6965--24.description:
Activate Lotus Ring's equip ability by paying {0}, attaching it to the Knight.
Activate the Knight by tapping and sacrificing it, adding three mana of any color.
Cast the Knight from your graveyard by paying its mana cost.
Repeat.
If the Knight has mana value 2 or less, this combo nets infinite mana.

856-3263-4779-6748-6757.description:
Cast Cauldron Familiar by paying {B}.
When Cauldron Familiar enters, it and Weapons Manufacturing trigger.
Resolve the Cauldron Familiar trigger, causing each opponent to lose 1 life and you to gain 1 life.
Resolve the Weapons Manufacturing trigger, creating a Munitions artifact token.
Activate Krark-Clan Grunt by sacrificing Cauldron Familiar.
Activate Cauldron Familiar by sacrificing the Munitions, as it is a Food due to Ragost.
The Munitions triggers, dealing 2 damage to any target.
Resolve the Cauldron Familiar ability, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.

2043-3129-5231-6671.description:
Activate Urza by paying {6}, creating two token copies of Magic Pot that are 1/1 Soldiers.
Activate Thermopod twice by sacrificing the Magic Pot tokens, adding {R}{R}.
When the Magic Pot tokens die, they trigger, creating four Treasure tokens.
Activate the Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {4}.
Repeat.

2634-4036-5049-5195.description:
Cast Seething Song by paying {2}{R}.
Storm-Kiln Artist triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Activate a Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {1}.
Holding priority, activate Rootha by paying {2} and returning it from the battlefield to your hand, copying Seething Song.
Storm-Kiln Artist triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Seething Song copy, adding {R}{R}{R}{R}{R}.
Activate a Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {U}.
Cast Rootha by paying {1}{U}{R}.
Repeat from step 4.

654-1479-2783-5700-5701.notablePrerequisites: You are able to play a land this turn.
654-1479-2783-5700-5701.description:
Play Petrified Field.
When Petrified Field enters the battlefield, Kodama of the East Tree and Nesting Dragon trigger.
Resolve the Kodama of the East Tree trigger, putting nothing onto the battlefield.
Holding priority, activate Petrified Field's second ability by tapping and sacrificing it, returning Echoing Deeps from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Nesting Dragon trigger, creating a token.
When the token enters the battlefield, Kodama of the East Tree triggers, putting Echoing Deeps from your hand onto the battlefield as a copy of Petrified Field.
When Echoing Deeps enters the battlefield, Nesting Dragon and Amulet of Vigor trigger.
Resolve the Amulet of Vigor trigger, untapping Echoing Deeps.
Holding priority, activate Echoing Deeps using Petrified Field's second ability by tapping and sacrificing it, returning Petrified Field from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Nesting Dragon trigger, creating a token.
When the token enters the battlefield, Kodama of the East Tree triggers, putting Petrified Field from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Petrified Field enters the battlefield, Nesting Dragon triggers.
Repeat from step 4.

440-671-1339-5231.notablePrerequisites: You have a way to draw a card.
440-671-1339-5231.description:
Draw a card.
The Locust God triggers, creating a 1/1 Insect creature token with flying and haste.
When the Insect enters the battlefield, Daxos triggers, causing you to gain 1 life.
Well of Lost Dreams triggers. Choose not to pay.
Activate Thermopod by sacrificing the Insect, adding {R}.
When the Insect dies, Daxos triggers, causing you to gain 1 life.
Well of Lost Dreams triggers, causing you to pay {1} to draw a card.
Repeat from step 2.

372-1309-3563.notablePrerequisites:
You have any number of other nonland permanents that enter the battlefield untapped, and that can collectively tap to produce enough mana to cast Flicker of Fate exiled by Abdel Adrian.
Salvager of Secrets exiled by Abdel Adrian.
You have enough mana to cast Flicker of Fate.
372-1309-3563.description:
Cast Flicker of Fate by paying its mana cost, blinking Abdel Adrian.
Abdel Adrian leaves the battlefield, returning Salvager of Secrets and all other cards that were exiled with it to the battlefield.
Abdel Adrian and Salvager of Secrets trigger.
Resolve the Salvager of Secrets trigger, returning Flicker of Fate from your graveyard to your hand.
Holding priority, activate any number of nonland permanents you control by tapping them, adding at least enough mana to cast Flicker of Fate.
Resolve the Abdel Adrian trigger, exiling Salvager of Secrets and the mana-producing permanents until Abdel Adrian leaves the battlefield, and creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token for each permanent exiled this way.
Repeat.

372-1018-3603.notablePrerequisites: You have any number of other nonland permanents that enter the battlefield untapped, and that can collectively tap to produce enough mana to cast Cloudshift exiled by Abdel Adrian.
372-1018-3603.description:
Cast Cloudshift by paying its mana cost, blinking Abdel Adrian.
Abdel Adrian leaves the battlefield, returning Skullwinder and all other cards that were exiled with it to the battlefield.
Abdel Adrian and Skullwinder trigger.
Resolve the Skullwinder trigger, returning Cloudshift from your graveyard to your hand.
Holding priority, activate any number of nonland permanents you control by tapping them, adding at least enough mana to cast Cloudshift.
Resolve the Abdel Adrian trigger, exiling Skullwinder and the mana-producing permanents until Abdel Adrian leaves the battlefield, and creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token for each permanent exiled this way.
Repeat.

1652-2092-4499.notablePrerequisites: Agatha of the Vile Cauldron has power 2 or greater.
1652-2092-4499.description:
Activate Emiel the Blessed by paying {1}, blinking Patron of the Arts.
When Patron of the Arts enters the battlefield, it triggers, creating a Treasure artifact token.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {1}.
Repeat.

1642-2682-2751.notablePrerequisites:
Your life total is at least three.
Warlock Class is level three.
1642-2682-2751.description:
Cast Dire Fleet Ravager by paying {3}{B}{B}.
Dire Fleet Ravager enters the battlefield, triggering its ability.
Holding priority, activate Strionic Resonator by paying {2} and tapping it, copying Dire Fleet Ravager's trigger.
Resolve the copy of Dire Fleet Ravager's trigger, causing each player to lose a third of their life total, rounded up.
Resolve the Dire Fleet Ravager trigger, causing each player to lose a third of their life total, rounded up.
At the beginning of your upkeep, Warlock Class triggers, causing each opponent to lose life equal to the life they lost this turn.
Each opponent loses the game due to having zero or less life.

2743-3893.manaNeeded: {1}{U} plus an additional {1}{G}{U} available if you control exactly three Shapeshifters
2743-3893.notablePrerequisites: You control at least three Shapeshifters.
2743-3893.description:
Cast Absorb Identity by paying {1}{U}, returning Biovisionary from the battlefield to your hand, and causing all Shapeshifters you control to become a copy of Biovisionary until end of turn.
If you control exactly three Shapeshifters, cast Biovisionary by paying {1}{G}{U}.
At the beginning of your end step, each Biovisionary triggers.
Resolve the first trigger, causing you to win the game.

3913-4089.description:
Cast Glasspool Mimic by paying {2}{U}, without using {R}, having it enter the battlefield as a copy of Crypt Champion.
Glasspool Mimic enters the battlefield, triggering its first and second abilities.
Resolve the second Glasspool Mimic trigger, causing you to sacrifice it.
Resolve the first Glasspool Mimic trigger, returning Glasspool Mimic from your graveyard to the battlefield as a copy of Crypt Champion.
Repeat from step 2.

3425-3490-4050.notablePrerequisites: You have a way to cause a creature to enter the battlefield.
3425-3490-4050.description:
Cause a creature to enter the battlefield.
Celebrity Fencer triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on itself.
Animation Module triggers, causing you to pay {1} to create a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token.
The Servo enters the battlefield, triggering Celebrity Fencer.
Holding priority, activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing the Servo, adding {1}.
Resolve the Celebrity Fencer trigger, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Repeat from step 3.

1267-4050-4897.notablePrerequisites:
Medomai in your graveyard.Olivia does not have summoning sickness.
An opponent is unable to block your creatures.
1267-4050-4897.description:
Declare Olivia as an attacker, attacking an opponent unable to block your creatures.
Olivia triggers, returning Medomai from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped and attacking that opponent.
Deal combat damage with Medomai, triggering its ability, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Medomai, adding one mana of any color.
Repeat.
